description: Run one standard report by name (list_standard_reports lists them and the arguments each takes) and return its rows. Pass only the arguments that report lists; any other is refused. Examples: report=top_selling_items with topN=10 and periodDays=30; report=sales_margin with periodDays=90; report=inventory_position with sortBy=runway. At most 200 rows.

categoryName.description: category_name: only items in this category.

groupBy.description: group_by: warehouse or sku (total or category for the summary).

horizonDays.description: horizon_days: planning or runway horizon in days.

numPeriods.description: num_periods: how many periods the matrix shows.

period.description: period: week, month or quarter (dead stock); day, week or month (matrix).

report.description: The report's name from list_standard_reports, e.g. top_selling_items.

name: run_standard_report
title: Run Standard Report
